Class RebelWheel

java.lang.Object
Wheel
RebelWheel
public class RebelWheel extends Wheel
A wheel that resists being locked, swapped or removed. It can still be spun and have its symbols changed like a normal Wheel. The restrictions are enforced by SlotMachine, which asks every wheel canBeLocked(), canBeSwapped() and canBeRemoved() before doing those actions.

1.0
Author:
